text:
maria: Observed regression after kernel-selector canary. Small-stream p50 parse 6.4ms (was 2.8ms). Pod CPU +70%. Repro:
```
./harness --mode=stream --seq-len=64 --chunk=64 --concurrency=40 --target=canary-host:8080
```
pprof sample (10s): 34% host.parse.tokenize; 22% host.stream.frame_parse; 18% kvcache.evict; 9% grpc.writev; 7% net.write.

ryan: Any recent changes around batch heuristics or key gen? kv evict spike looks correlated.

ash: Kernel-selector lowered mini_batch_hint on canary to favor throughput. Could cause more frequent flushes / smaller writev coalescing.

kai: Traces show kvcache miss canary ~43% vs prod ~12%. Keys differ by header byte order (we started canonicalizing headers in proto->key path).

lee: If ordering changed identical requests produce different key bytes -> high cold inserts and evictions.

maria: I toggled KERNEL_HINT=legacy: parse p50 returns ~2.9ms and miss rate drops to ~14%. Strong signal.

ash: Likely twofold: mini-batching reduction increases parse/write frequency; nondeterministic key bytes cause kvcache churn.

lee: Mitigation: (1) implement stable kvcache key serializer (deterministic header order), (2) enforce min_mini_batch=8 in kernel-selector as a short-term guard. Prioritize key serializer.

maria: Opening PRs (draft): kernel: https://git.redwood/infer/commit/abf1 ; kvcache-key: https://git.redwood/infer/commit/cd21. Will run microbench and post before/after pprofs.

perf-bot: perf alert perf-1812223333 created and routed to #eng-runtime oncall.

ash: Add small-chunk streaming microbench to CI. kai: add telemetry rule for kvcache miss% >20% over 5m.

maria: Will update thread with pprof diffs after validation. Thanks.
